note: Every route is in time order and never moves back, and ends at `end`.
about: The points a progress bar's fill goes through, from fillRoute in lib/progress-bar.ts. Glides are [from, to, at, seconds, ceiling] for evenGlide in lib/time-left.ts; times in ms, shares from 0 to 1, compared to 4 decimal places. `first` and `second` are [at, share, easing]; `reaches` is [share, at], the point at that share and when (to the ms); `crawl` is the speed of the last stretch in shares a second, to 5 places; `still` means no points, the fill standing at `end`.

cases.name: glides from where it stands now through its end, slows down past it and crawls on to its ceiling
eases over 0.3 s to a glide that starts ahead of where it stands, then goes on along it
stands still at its ceiling when it has nowhere left to go
